8. Conclusions & Recommendations

Key Findings

Best Original Model: Tabpfn Randomundersampler with balanced accuracy of 0.8698
Error Patterns: Most common confusion is between classes 0 and 3, suggesting these classes may benefit from additional feature engineering

Recommendations for Deployment

  1. Model Selection: Use top-performing models (LGBM, TabPFN, or XGBoost) with engineered features for production deployment
  2. Feature Engineering: Include the 56 engineered features in the production pipeline for improved performance
  3. Monitoring: Implement monitoring for the most confused class pairs identified in error analysis
  4. Ensemble Approach: Consider ensemble methods combining top 3-5 models for more robust predictions
  5. Continuous Improvement: Regularly update models with new data and re-evaluate feature importance

Next Steps

  • Apply feature engineering to Single dataset for comparison
  • Implement probability calibration for improved confidence estimates
  • Deploy best model with monitoring infrastructure
  • Set up A/B testing framework for model comparison in production
